title: Eval
subtitle: Score the real harness and runtime on isolated workspaces. User conversations are never written.
isolationNote: Each case runs production AgentEngine in a private workspace under diagnostics/agent-evals. Office suites use the Office profile (Read/Write/Edit); coding suites install CodingHarness. MCP, browser, computer-use, and web search stay off. One run at a time. Use Office tasks for office KPIs and Aider Polyglot / ClassEval for coding-agent KPIs — HumanEval is only a unit-coding floor. Expand a case for the full trajectory and artifacts; in-flight runs stream the live trace.
developerModeRequired: Turn on Developer Mode in Settings → System to use evals.

form.modelSelectTooltip: Model used by the live eval harness. Default uses the first enabled chat model.
form.modelUnavailableHint: This saved model is no longer available. Choose another model or Default Model.
